config_contents.description: Neural distributional regression (DRN, censored shifted gamma) against the published pipeline and EMOS, September-initialized ONDJ (docs/54).

provenance.uncommitted_check: code and configuration files this result depends on

pathway: B: rainfall-distribution models from the raw ensemble

emos_csg.name: EMOS, censored shifted gamma
emos_csg.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero
emos_csg.predictors: ensemble mean m' and mean absolute difference md' (relative)

drn_csg.name: Distributional regression network (DRN), censored shifted gamma
drn_csg.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_csg.predictors: m', ensemble median, s', md', ensemble 10% and 90% quantiles (relative), log climatological mean, CHIRPS coefficient of variation, latitude, longitude
drn_csg.fitting: shared MLP (32 or 32-16 ELU units) -> CSG parameters; CRPS + weight decay; early stopping on held-out years; architecture and decay by validation CRPS, pooled

drn_linear_csg.name: Linear CSG with the DRN inputs and CRPS (control)
drn_linear_csg.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_linear_csg.fitting: no hidden layer; CRPS; early stopping on held-out years, pooled

drn_climatology.name: DRN without the forecast (climatology and location; ablation)
drn_climatology.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_climatology.predictors: log climatological mean, CHIRPS coefficient of variation, latitude, longitude (no SEAS5 input)

references.incumbent: MVS -> smoothed counts -> climatology blend (published probabilities)

accepted.note: first DRN benchmark: architectures 32 and 32-16, weight decay fixed at 1e-4; published in releases 2026-10-20.0 to .4
